text:
maria: Heads up — deploy-bot flagged runtime v2.15.0 causing tail latency spikes on longseq workloads. Proposing a temporary 'pin-backoff' (throttle new picks) for 4h while we investigate. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: alert: runtime v2.15.0 elevated p95 tail latency on seq>1024 (+12%). Auto-rollback not triggered. Suggested action: pin affected pools to v2.14.x. See https://redwood.inc/ops/INC-2026 for details.

james: +1 to temp pin. Can we scope to region/us-east and model tag=longseq-only? Want minimal blast radius.

sarah: Can we do a soft-throttle instead: prefer v2.14 for new connections but keep existing sessions on v2.15? That should reduce disruption for in-flight requests.

kevin: Metrics show QPS stable but GPU memory pressure and occasional kernel OOMs on 2.15 for quantized llama3q runs. If we pin, also disable new autoscale for those pools until we understand mem regression.

maria: OK action plan: I'll request a pin-backoff for pools 'dedicated-longseq-us-east' and 'dedicated-longseq-eu' for 4h starting now. @deploy-bot can you annotate release notes and set a rollback checkpoint at 2h?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pinned runtime -> from v2.15.0 to v2.14.8; reason: tail latency regression on longseq; scope: [dedicated-longseq-us-east, dedicated-longseq-eu]; duration: 4h; created_by: maria; ts:2141598756

james: :thumbsup: please post the preflight/unpin checklist so on-call knows the criteria for rollback/unpin.

sarah: I'll run the compat + fuzz suite for v2.15 on a 3-node canary and post findings in ~30m.

kevin: If fuzz finds kernel OOM or allocator regressions, we should hold unpin until kernel/kernelspec bump lands. Also update docs about kv_cache eviction changes in 2.15 that might affect longseq.

sarah: Fuzz/canary update: found repeatable latency spike when batch_size>32 on quantized llama3q; heap traces indicate increased memcpy stalls. Uploading logs to #eng-runtime and filing a repro in INC-2026.

maria: Decision for now: keep pin active until root cause is identified and a patch is validated. Created ops ticket RN-2026. @james can you draft customer comms for affected Dedicated pools? We'll offer rollback credit if we missed capacity planning.

james: Noted — customer comms draft will go to #product and #sales for review.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin reminder: current pin expires in 3h30m unless extended. current_pinned_runtime: v2.14.8; pin_id: pin-2141598756

maria: Thanks everyone. Reconvene in 2h for status. If sarah's canary gets a clean pass and kernel traces look good, we'll consider a soft-unpin with a gradual ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) and 15m monitoring windows. Otherwise we keep the pin and continue investigation.
